chatham-islands-7.name: Basalt Columns
chatham-islands-7.bio: Columnar basalt at Ohira Bay on Petre Bay, formed about 80 million years ago and reached over private land.
chatham-islands-7.hours: By arrangement (private land; gate key and permission needed)
notes: Entry fee confirmed by the tourism board but the NZD 25 amount is from one undated third-party blog; verify with the landowner (Jonathon Reriti 0277050073). No ticketUrl: only a Tourism Chatham Islands page exists (no operator site).
Gate key arrangement (Hotel Chathams per Wikivoyage) unverified.

chatham-islands-8.name: Point Munning Seal Colony
chatham-islands-8.bio: A 47 ha private covenant on the north-east coast where a short bush walk leads to a seal haul-out beach.
notes: Held: needs a photo, and the entry fee amount is not published (ask Muirson family 03 3050 022). No cost written: not free. No ticketUrl (tourism board page only).

chatham-islands-9.name: Admiral Gardens
chatham-islands-9.bio: A garden planted for birds, bees and butterflies, with a wetland reserve, coastal bush and a dune walk to Long Beach.
notes: Held: needs a photo. Coordinates moved to the OSM 'Admiral Garden' node (placement point was a spot on Port Hutt Rd 6+ km west). NZD 10 pp from an undated tourism-board listing. Name follows placement ('Admiral Gardens'); sources say 'Admiral Garden'. No ticketUrl (tourism board accommodation page only).

chatham-islands-10.name: Awatotara Bush Coastal Walk
chatham-islands-10.bio: A walk of 2.5 to 3 hours through native bush to a rugged coast, on private land by arrangement with Tuku Tours.
notes: Held: needs a photo. NZD 15 independent / 20 guided from Wikivoyage (Oct 2018), possibly stale. Coordinate is the Tuku Tours farm start, not a surveyed trailhead. No ticketUrl (tourism board page only).

chatham-islands-11.name: German Mission House
chatham-islands-11.bio: A Category 1 stone mission house built in 1866-68 by German Moravian missionaries, open by appointment.
chatham-islands-11.hours: By appointment (Tuesday to Friday per one third-party source)
notes: NZD 20 and visiting days from one undated blog; fee confirmed by tourism board and Wikivoyage without an amount. Phone 03 3050 653 or 027 3050 302 to confirm. Tourism board names it 'Maunganui Stone Cottage'; no ticketUrl. No Wikipedia article, so no wiki.

chatham-islands-12.name: Port Hutt
chatham-islands-12.bio: A sheltered cove in Whangaroa Harbour where American scientists watched the 1874 transit of Venus, now a picnic spot.
notes: Held for cost: the tourism board says an entry fee is payable but no amount is published (contact 03 3050011). Not free. Placement's 'interpretation shelter' is not in the sources and was dropped. Photo is ready. No ticketUrl.

chatham-islands-13.name: Kaingaroa
chatham-islands-13.bio: A fishing village on the north-east coast with a harbour once used by sealers and whalers, and a walk to a beach.
notes: No Wikipedia article ('Kaingaroa' is a disambiguation page), so no wiki; photo comes from the placement override. No ticketUrl (village).

chatham-islands-14.name: Ocean Mail Scenic Reserve
chatham-islands-14.bio: An 831 ha peat dome and wetland reserve by Te Whanga Lagoon with 4 km of dunes and walks of 15 minutes to 2.5 hours.
notes: Held: needs a photo. Coordinates moved to the start of the Aster Walk (OSM); which end holds the car park is unverified. DOC calls it Manauea/Ocean Mail Scenic Reserve.

chatham-islands-15.name: Nikau Bush Conservation Area
chatham-islands-15.bio: A 19 ha fenced forest on Te Whanga Lagoon with the largest stand of nikau on the main island, reached by a 1 km uphill walk.
notes: Held: needs a photo. wiki is the macron article title per research.

chatham-islands-16.name: Chatham Islands Museum
chatham-islands-16.bio: A community museum in Waitangi on the islands' natural and social history, from fossils and rare birds to Moriori items.
notes: Held: needs a photo. Hours from the museum's own site (9am-2pm Mon-Fri, 'most days'); the tourism board page conflicts (8:30am-4:30pm). Residents free. Public holiday closures unverified.

chatham-islands-17.name: Henga Scenic Reserve
chatham-islands-17.bio: A 170 ha reserve of sand dunes, coastal forest and limestone outcrops, with a walk to a lookout over Petre Bay.
notes: Held: needs a photo. Coordinates moved to the OSM path start on North Road (medium confidence; the old point is private Henga Lodge). Hotel Chatham's guided Henga walk is separate private land.

chatham-islands-2.wiki: Hāpūpū / J M Barker Historic Reserve
chatham-islands-2.hours: Guided visits by arrangement (book via Hotel Chatham or Awarakau Lodge)
notes: Current free:true and 'Open 24 hours' contradict DOC (visitors other than local whanau book a guided tour with DOC-approved operators). No guided-tour price in any source, so no cost written; owner to ask Hotel Chatham (03 3050 048). Current photo is a single-carving close-up; confirm separately. The DOC slug .../hapupu-national-historic-reserve/ 404s; the jm-barker slug is used.

chatham-islands-6.hours: Guided group tours by booking (Wednesdays 10:00 AM per Wikivoyage, 2018)
notes: No tour fee published anywhere; free:true was unsupported, so removed and no cost written (owner to confirm: 03 3050 450, office@kopinga.co.nz). Wednesday tour is from a 2018 listing. No Wikipedia article exists. Current photo is an archive black-and-white photo of people and needs a replacement (Hokotehi Moriori Trust or tourism board, permission needed).

chatham-islands-3.hours: Guided day tours by arrangement (flights depart about 9:00 AM, return about 4:30 PM)
notes: Replaces 150-250: Flowerpot Adventures 2026-27 day tour is NZD 495 pp (flight or boat, 4x4 tour, lunch); Hotel Chatham up to NZD 500. Sold by several operators plus Air Chathams, so no ticketUrl (tourism board region page https://chathamislands.co.nz/our-islands/regions/pitt-island/ if one is wanted). No wiki needed: article 'Pitt Island' matches the name.

chatham-islands-4.bio: The only town in the Chathams, a small port with a wharf, a pub, a shop and the 10-minute Tikitiki Hill lookout walk.
notes: Tikitiki Hill confirmed by DOC (10-minute return walk, views over the wharf and harbour). Cost, hours and wiki unchanged.
Held (not applied until resolved): -8 -9 -10 -14 -15 -16 -17 need a photo; -8 and -12 also have no published entry fee amount (not free, so no cost written).
Tourism Chatham Islands pages are not operator sites, so ticketUrl is omitted for private-land spots; DOC and museum/Moriori Trust pages are used where verified.
Costs from undated blogs or Wikivoyage 2018 (Basalt Columns 25, Admiral Gardens 10, Awatotara 15-20, German Mission House 20) are approximate; owner to confirm.
Hapupu and Kopinga Marae lose free:true and have no cost until a guided-tour price is found.
